sloka: मा शुचः पुरुषव्याघ्र कालस्य गतिरीदृशी ।त्वद्विधा न हि शोचन्ति बुद्धिमन्तो मनस्विनः ।। ७.५२.१० ॥
transliteration: mā śucaḥ puruṣavyāghra kālasya gatirīdṛśī ।tvadvidhā na hi śocanti buddhimanto manasvinaḥ ।। 7.52.10 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, do not grieve, for such is the course of time, and intelligent, high-minded individuals like you certainly do not lament.
